user_goal: Apply the verified CodeRabbit corrections to the v0.1.9 release-hygiene candidate without mutating its sealed authority.

authority.verbatim_text: Address the actionable rollback and checkpoint finding and the two verified release-test nitpicks, then continue the reviewed v0.1.9 release.

baseline.selection_reason: The successor authorizes only corrections required by the real PR 3 review.

semantic_changes: Document the exact lease-bound rollback exception.
Bind checkpoint to the full reviewed source candidate.
Keep portable schema coverage independent of method names.
Assert exact release-pointer path, ID parity, and absence of direct workflow override.

No unrelated feature, ledger mutation, foreign listener takeover, secret exposure, tag rewrite, or force push except the documented exact-lease rollback with audit retention, public verification, and live attestation.

invariants: The original v0.1.9 contract remains byte-identical and validator-valid.
Only the verified review findings change.
Portable owner-schema coverage runs without Windows tooling.
Release authority remains one canonical tracked pointer.
No merge or release before fresh exact-head CodeRabbit, CI, independent review, verifier, and guard PASS.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Original and successor contracts, exact diff, and all corrections validate.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: In-place contract mutation or scope widening.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: PR 3 review threads and exact-head CI are green.
Signed receipts, verifier, and guard approve exact v0.1.9.
Public and installed v0.1.9 are exact, healthy, and clean.

proof_requirements.claim: Both contracts and the narrow correction are independently valid.
All PR review and CI evidence is green at exact head.
Signed chain is accepted by verifier and guard.
Public and live artifacts match and checkout stays clean.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Actions, tag, package, owner, connector, health, git status

release_requirements.required_receipt: signed chain accepted by verifier and guard

stop_conditions: Original contract drift, unexpected diff, unresolved review, failed CI, non-PASS receipt, SHA mismatch, or live/rollback failure.
known_discrepancies: The original candidate received a valid MERGE_READY FAIL receipt; only a fresh successor review can supersede it.
